push.title: L 1-2 vs Higher Crowd | You: 7.5 (5th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, your 5th worst match performance of the season with a 7.5. Speed bump, not a wall.

THE GOOD
+ 90% passing on 21 attempts, up from your usual 84%. Possession is nine-tenths of the law, and you were the sheriff.
+ A goal against Higher Crowd. One swing, one goal, zero doubt.
+ Tackles attempted 6, up from your usual 2. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ 8th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ Team-high 1 key passes. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.

THE BAD
- Missed tackles 5, up from your usual 1. Let's not make that a pattern.
- Red card. Here's how: No slide tackles from behind or as the last defender. A red card costs us the whole match. Easy as pie.
- 0.4 under average. Even good weeks have a rainy day.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 21 (best was BellyTb1's 27). Quick fix: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.

THE UGLY
! Red card: the team played a player down for the rest of it. Flat out: that cost us the match. Homework: If you're beaten, sprint the recovery run goal-side instead of reaching in.

PhogsToffees, something I want you to sleep on: Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

Stay hungry, stay humble. - Coach Lasso

strengths.title: Chance creation

tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.title: L 1-2 vs Higher Crowd | You: 7.3 (4th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.3 against Higher Crowd, your 4th worst match performance of the season. Little off, nothing broken.

THE GOOD
+ 1 assist. You're the opener on the team's toolbelt.
+ That link with PhogsToffees was smoother than a Cadillac on new pavement.
+ Tackles attempted 5, up from your usual 2. More of that, please and thank you.
+ Team-high 2 shots. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 2 goals conceded: +0.1. That's money in the bank.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Back to basics: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound. That's a promise.
- 62% passing (15 of 24, down from your usual 86%). Next rep: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Next match, nail it.
- Your 4th worst match performance of the season: 7.3. Fixable, every bit of it.
- BellyTb1 and you both slipped on forcing passes. Catch each other: give each other short options.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Here's the trick: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.

Warm-up idea: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

Before you go, buddskees: The ball doesn't know your rating. Neither should your attitude.

Water the plant; it'll grow. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-2 vs Higher Crowd | You: 7.2 (5th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, your 5th worst match performance of the season: 7.2. Not your night, still your team.

THE GOOD
+ Tackle success 100%, up from your usual 26%. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ Team-high 27 passes attempted. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ 1 shot on target bumped you +0.1. Love it.
+ 2 goals conceded: +0.1. Solid foundation stuff.

THE BAD
- 56% passing (15 of 27, down from your usual 77%). One more thing: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- You and buddskees need to sync up on forcing passes: give each other short options.
- 0.5 below your typical game. Next one's the bounce-back.
- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 1. That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 4 (best was PhogsToffees's 6). Here's the deal: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.

Drill of the day: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: If plan A doesn't work, the alphabet has 25 more letters.

I'm in your corner, always. - Coach Lasso
